confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established five H-pattern gears on a standard gate, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shift, and the absence of automatic cut and blip.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.

additional_telemetry_names.basis: Unsuffixed configuration of the same car, observed exactly at Daytona. Which aero package that is was not established: these cars carry a base package as well as high and low downforce, and the unsuffixed name may be the base rather than the low-downforce one. AMS2 selects it by circuit, so a driver reaches it without choosing it. Controls are inherited from the driven high-downforce configuration and were not separately tested.
